title: AI is really good at code, holy shit
author: Physical-Bite-3837
selftext:
I hadn't used it before so I decided to start with something simple. I wanted to make a simple platformer in game maker very reminiscent of Donkey Kong Country because that was my favorite game growing up as a kid. It gave me perfect code for all the collectables, multiple enemies that behave in different ways, all types of moving platforms, checkpoints, extra lives, bonus rooms, an animal buddy I can mount on and ride... it even told me how to make an entire barrel blasting system that feels exactly like the one in DKC. All set up within a day.

DUDE. Back when I was trying to learn game maker like 15 years ago I spent an entire week trying to figure out how to get a player on a vertical moving platform without it getting stuck. And back then I was in school plus work, so I just didn't have time to learn it as much as I wanted to. 

I fear I might be succumbing to the amazing power of the AI. It's only a matter of time now before I look and sound like gollum from lord of the rings.

comments.author: Available-March1619
comments.body:
First code I ever wrote was like 1984 in 7th grade ‘Computer Lab’ class. Because, in 1984 these computers were the thing kids needed to know (eye roll)….first code I ever wrote was blinky text. Second code I learned was how to make the blinky text change color from Red to Green to Blue.  
Yah.  
Today….40+ years later, are you kidding me?  
I just asked one of my AI agents to make sure the agent on my Mac is running the same version of Blender.  
What?
